author: felicepantaleo
body:
This PR fixes three defects in `TICLCandidateValidator` (`Validation/HGCalValidation`), which fills the `HGCalValidator/ticlCandidates` folders offline and `HGCalValidator/hltTiclCandidate` at HLT.

- Wrong candidate: the efficiency loops took `auto& recoCand = TICLCandidates[cand_idx]` and then assigned the candidate they found to it. `cand_idx` is an index in the merged trackster collection, not in the candidates. So the assignment wrote the found candidate over another element of the local copy of the collection, and every later lookup in the event saw the changed collection. An index past the end of the candidates was undefined behaviour. The loops now take a reference to the candidate that `find_if` returns.
- Track cut: for each track of a simulated charged candidate, the cut was applied to the first track of the candidate (`cutTk(*simCand.trackPtr())`). It is now applied to each track.
- Indices: the indices of tracks and tracksters came from pointer arithmetic against the first element of a collection. They now come from `edm::Ptr::key()`, and a `Ptr` into a product other than the validated tracks or tracksters throws. The validator no longer copies the candidate, track and trackster collections.
title: TICLCandidateValidator bug fixes
